visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and a light grey short-sleeved shirt stands in a modern office with glass partitions and white walls. He holds a large black handheld gaming console with both hands, looking at the camera. Yellow text "Switch 2開箱" appears in the center. (2) The man is now seated on a beige sofa in a room with white sheer curtains and bright, soft lighting. He holds the handheld console, pointing at the screen which shows a user interface with various icons. (3) A close-up shot focuses on the handheld screen displaying a 3D racing game with a character in a vehicle. The man's hands are visible on the sides of the device. (4) Short clips show various gameplay scenes on the console screen: a futuristic car in a neon city and characters walking through a medieval hallway. A technical tool with an orange case and a digital display is briefly used to measure the screen's brightness. (5) The man appears again on the sofa, speaking animatedly while holding the console. He uses hand gestures to emphasize his points. (6) A shot of the console sitting in a grey docking station is shown. The video then cuts back to the man delivering his final summary to the camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: Switch 2開箱. [Subtitle]: 各位我已經測完最新的. (2) [Subtitle]: 任天堂 Switch 2. (3) [Subtitle]: 來直接講一下我的感想. (4) [Subtitle]: 感想就是 如果你要長時間. (5) [Subtitle]: 把它當作掌機玩的話. (6) [Subtitle]: 我覺得這一代可以再觀望一下. (7) [Subtitle]: 因為呢 續航測下來玩重度遊戲. (8) [Subtitle]: 大概只有兩個小時. (9) [Subtitle]: 然後螢幕表現雖然有提升. (10) [Subtitle]: 但是呢 它的 HDR 表現效果不怎麼樣. (11) [Subtitle]: 然後它還是 LCD 的這個螢幕. (12) [Subtitle]: 所以我覺得可以等 Switch 2 OLED. (13) [Subtitle]: 就是未來的版本就好了. (14) [Subtitle]: 但如果你是長時間把它接電視. (15) [Subtitle]: 底座模式玩的話呢. (16) [Subtitle]: 這一代其實還是蠻值得買的. (17) [Subtitle]: 因為它接電視 4K 的那個表現. (18) [Subtitle]: 包括了薩爾達 然後包括了瑪利歐賽車世界等等的. (19) [Subtitle]: 那個解析度的提升是非常有感. (20) [Subtitle]: 而且它的價格也不貴 台幣14,380而已. (21) [Subtitle]: 講結論 當家機可以買. (22) [Subtitle]: 當掌機的話呢 就再觀望一下.
